changelog: A new score. Five fully produced music beds replace the old sampled ones, which players had called a MIDI mock-up: one for the menu, one for ordinary battles, and new tracks of their own for elite fights, boss fights and the final act's climax, which crossfades in when he rises. Each song's opening now plays the first time you hear it and resumes inside the loop on later visits. Mac: universal (Apple Silicon and Intel), Developer ID signed, notarized and stapled. Minimum macOS 11. Controller support is confirmed working on the Mac. 1,316 tests.
